roster_source: Marae Moana official biodiversity page, Cook Islands 15-island roster; see references.md
roster_vintage: Page undated; population column explicitly 2011; island roster treated as current-page descriptive reference, not a legal boundary list
disposition: Neighboring-granularity and atlas-coverage handoff only. This issue cannot add locations or invent IDs. Separate source and engineering scope is required.
scope_rule: A same-name feature is counted only when reference_owner is Cook Islands. Other-country homonyms are recorded as collisions and do not represent Cook Islands islands.
